functions.resolveScheduled: (s) => with(series(s.seriesId), se => with(se && find(se.units, u => u.id == s.unitId), unit => with(unit && find(unit.lessons, l => l.id == s.lessonId), lesson => se && unit && lesson ? { series: se, unit, lesson } : null)))
functions.lessonFile: (lesson, title) => ({ type: 'file', id: lesson.id, title: title ?? lesson.title, mediaType: 'video', url: lesson.videoUrl, thumbnail: lesson.thumbnail, providerData: { sourceUrl: lesson.sourceUrl } })

routes.browse: concat(len(datasets.catalog.scheduledLessons) > 0 ? [{ type: 'folder', id: 'scheduled', title: 'This Sunday', path: '/scheduled' }] : [], map(datasets.catalog.series, s => ({ type: 'folder', id: s.id, title: s.name, thumbnail: s.thumbnail, path: '/' + s.id })))

map(datasets.catalog.scheduledLessons || [], s => with(resolveScheduled(s), r => ({ type: 'folder', id: s.id, title: scheduledLabel(s, r), thumbnail: r ? r.lesson.thumbnail ?? r.unit.thumbnail : null, isLeaf: true, path: '/scheduled/' + s.id })))

routes.instructions: files ? filesToInstructions(scheduledLabel(s, r), files, 'scheduled-' + s.id + '-section', 'This Sunday') : null

routes.browse: se ? map(se.units, u => ({ type: 'folder', id: u.id, title: u.name, thumbnail: u.thumbnail ?? se.thumbnail, path: '/' + se.id + '/' + u.id })) : []
unit ? map(unit.lessons, l => ({ type: 'folder', id: l.id, title: l.title, thumbnail: l.thumbnail, isLeaf: true, path: '/' + se.id + '/' + unit.id + '/' + l.id })) : []
routes.instructions: unit ? filesToInstructions(unit.name, map(unit.lessons, l => lessonFile(l)), unit.id + '-section', unit.name) : null

getCurrentPlan.return: with(sortBy(datasets.catalog.scheduledLessons || [], s => s.weekOf, 'text', true)[0], sched => sched ? with(resolveScheduled(sched), r => r ? { id: sched.id, title: sched.ageGroup + ' — ' + r.lesson.title, serviceDate: sched.weekOf, thumbnail: r.lesson.thumbnail ?? r.unit.thumbnail ?? r.series.thumbnail, files: [{ id: r.lesson.id, name: r.lesson.title, url: r.lesson.videoUrl, image: r.lesson.thumbnail, seconds: 0 }] } : null) : null)
